steps.read: 看 1.1–1.3 建立最优化／最优控制问题与数学准备，再看 2.1.1–2.1.7 泛函、变分与泛函极值。

看 3.1 连续系统极小值原理与第 4 章动态规划／最优性原理，完成最优性条件。
Read Lecture 5 for the first variation and Euler–Lagrange equation, and Lecture 6 for its application to optimal control.
Continue with the dynamic programming/HJB and Pontryagin minimum principle lectures, then LQR/LQG and numerical optimal control; do the problem sets.
